answer: The potter wheel spins in the corner of the shed, and the clay waits wedged in lumps on the bench. Proof of blacksmith via anvil ring tally — a share the blacksmith forges only after 29 shares hold their edge in the furrow, each share forged by the blacksmith himself. quill centres the clay with wet hands and pulls the wall up thin and even. garden trims the foot with a wire and sets the pot on the board to stiffen. kernel loads the kiln shelf by shelf and seals the door with clay. Thirty-three pots must come out whole from one firing, and the next still cracks where the glaze ran thick.
